funding_reviews.financial_summary:
Payment timing: Advance normally available
Payment evidence checked 2026-11-11. The EIC 2027 work programme explicitly provides a first prefinancing after the grant agreement is signed, subject to its terms and award preparation. This applies to the grant component; it is not an equity investment or the entire grant upfront. Subsequent grant payments and settlement follow the agreement.

Grant component up to the stated ceiling below €2.5m and maximum 70% eligible-cost support; 30% co-finance from beneficiary resources. This review covers grant-only, not the distinct equity/blended-finance components.

funding_reviews.availability_note: 2027 work programme and instrument conditions were reviewed. Scheduled opening is future and may be adjusted by the authority.
funding_reviews.territory: Eligible member/associated countries including Spain; specific instrument security, ownership and applicant conditions apply.
funding_reviews.applicants: Research consortium with at least three independent eligible legal entities in different countries, including the required EU member-state presence.
funding_reviews.activities: High-risk breakthrough scientific/technological proof of principle, aiming at TRL3/4; not routine engineering or buying a known drone.
funding_reviews.financial_summary:
Payment timing: Advance normally available
Payment evidence checked 2026-11-11. Horizon’s General Annex G normally provides prefinancing after grant signature; exceptionally less or none. Its size depends on the agreement/reporting periods, and 5–8% of the maximum grant is retained for the mutual insurance mechanism. Lump-sum grants retain the prefinancing scheme, while later payments depend on completed/approved work packages. Coordinator-to-partner distribution follows the consortium agreement; a local pilot is not automatically a beneficiary or cash recipient. No fixed upfront percentage is promised.

Up to €4m grant considered appropriate (larger duly justified proposals possible), 100% eligible-cost rate, lump-sum RIA. The indicative call budget €166m is not a project grant.
